decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application would help restore the external historic integrity of the listed building to the benefit of  its amenity and the character of the conservation area as a whole, and would also comply with the aims of policies Env-B.2.5 and Env-B.2.7.
Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
description: Erection of part two storey, part single storey rear extension, incorporating new roof terrace on first floor with balustrade and erection of single storey side extension, new pitched roof to existing garage, installation of three new windows to side elevation on ground and first floor levels, replacement of rear windows and roof light, replacement of all tile hanging and roof covering, erection of new front boundary fencing and double gates internal and external alterations to house.
